page: Amazon Web Services m7i.12xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with a dedicated Intel Xeon 8488C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. The configuration includes 48 virtual CPUs, representing 24 physical cores with 2 threads per core, and a 105 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 5 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 19 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance in several areas, particularly in CPU-bound and memory-intensive operations. The instance achieved a Passmark CPU score of 63240.19 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 16969.0, both falling into the strong category. It demonstrates high efficiency in text processing, image processing, and ray tracing. For database workloads, the server processed 63.12 million Redis SET operations per second and scored 23984.46 on Passmark database operations. Large-block memory read bandwidth was measured at 179.25 GB/sec, while write bandwidth reached 84.16 GB/sec.

The processor supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512. These hardware features contribute to strong performance in low-latency tasks such as large language model inference. For a small 135M model, the instance achieved a top-tier text generation speed of 351.99 tokens per second. However, for larger models like the 70B parameter model, text generation speed drops to an average tier of 3.18 tokens per second, highlighting a performance tradeoff when running massive models without dedicated GPU acceleration. The instance is suited for enterprise application hosting, database operations, static web serving, and moderate machine learning inference.
